evals.name: ui-only-diff-routes-to-ui-skills
evals.prompt: I changed client/src/app/agents/_components/AgentCard/AgentCard.tsx (added a useEffect that copies props into state). Run /pr-self-review.
evals.expected_output: plan.mjs routes AgentCard.tsx to react-best-practices, next-best-practices, security is NOT run (no security trigger), and no backend skills run. The derived-state useEffect is reported as major (react-best-practices). Verdict PASS WITH WARNINGS, PR creation ALLOWED.

evals.name: backend-layering-violation-blocks
evals.prompt: I added `import { db } from '../../db/client'` and a direct db.select() inside server/src/modules/pulls/service.ts. Open a PR for this branch.
evals.expected_output: Skill triggers before gh pr create. service.ts is routed to onion-architecture, drizzle-orm-patterns (content), security. onion-architecture reports a critical layering violation, a verifier confirms it, finalize exits 1 with BLOCKED, gate.mjs prints FORBIDDEN and the agent does NOT run gh pr create.

evals.name: edited-migration-is-unwaivable
evals.prompt: I fixed a typo in server/src/db/migrations/0003_minor_overlord.sql and added a waiver row for hard#migration-edited. Run /pr-self-review.
evals.expected_output: hard#migration-edited critical is reported by plan.mjs; the waiver is ignored with a 'cannot be waived' warning; verdict BLOCKED; fix suggests restoring the file and running pnpm db:generate.

evals.name: new-skill-is-unmapped
evals.prompt: I just added .claude/skills/tailwind-rules/SKILL.md and changed a component. Run /pr-self-review.
evals.expected_output: Report warnings list 'Unmapped skill `tailwind-rules`' with advice to add it to config.json; the review still completes for mapped skills.

evals.name: stale-verdict-reruns
evals.prompt: (after a PASS) I edited one more file. Now create the PR.
evals.expected_output: gate.mjs prints FORBIDDEN (diff-hash differs); the agent re-runs the review; files unchanged since the last run are taken from cache (plan shows cached > 0); only the edited file is re-reviewed.

evals.name: hardcoded-ui-text
evals.prompt: I added <button>Delete agent</button> to AgentCard.tsx without a translation key. Run /pr-self-review.
evals.expected_output: repo-checks#i18n major finding pointing at the exact line; verdict PASS WITH WARNINGS.
